note: Release dates of the writers. 62 were copied on 2026-10-04 from the hand-kept model ledger of the Atlas. The rest were looked up the same day and carry a source in `sources`: for most, the date the model was listed on OpenRouter, checked on two models against the ledger (exact, and one day off); for a few, the lab's announcement. nousresearch/hermes-4-405b is corrected from the ledger's 2005-08-06 to 2025-08-26. Left without a date: qwen/qwen-max and qwen/qwen-vl-plus (aliases that have pointed to different models), nousresearch/k3-hf-fp8 (not found).
